title: Customer acknowledgment notes
summary: This topic is mostly brief service-writeup notes stating that the customer acknowledged information, with too little detail in most fragments to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: One positive fragment says the customer found the guidance helpful and would try the suggested approach.

undetermined.summary: Most fragments only note that the customer acknowledged something, without enough context to tell whether the acknowledgment reflects satisfaction, agreement, or a procedural record.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are extremely short acknowledgment notes with minimal context, so sentiment cannot be reliably determined.
The topic appears to capture procedural wording in service records rather than a clearly defined customer experience theme.
Examples are insufficient to identify specific recurring issues, actions, or outcomes beyond acknowledgment language.
